title: Give Antigravity2 an explicit qualified auth-probe timeout policy
base_sha_note: base_sha is the exact parent of this task's committed head (PR #5775, task/OPS-ANTIGRAVITY2-AUTH-PROBE-TIMEOUT-PARITY-001 branched from dev tip 6f00d0eb38e57946fe784de493df4606a55169b3). source_baseline records the earlier diagnostic/source dev tip b356d5ee2c20c0746e6281a4cc859a4ef33e7c3a that the SOURCE_REVIEW/EXECUTION_PLAN audit evidence was originally captured against; the two differ because dev advanced linearly between diagnosis and task branch creation.

reference_precedent.diagnosis: The primary antigravity provider was previously bounded by the platform-wide 45-second auth-probe subprocess timeout even though its CLI uses a 90-second print timeout, which could cache a transient OAuth startup failure for a full failed-probe interval and leave a quota-healthy lane idle. That task qualified providers.antigravity.auth_probe = {probe_timeout_seconds: 120, failed_probe_interval_seconds: 60}.
reference_precedent.gap: antigravity2 shares the same antigravity CLI/adapter shape (.orchestrator/provider_permissions.py::_antigravity_auth_probe) but was never given the matching auth_probe block, so it silently fell back to AUTH_PROBE_DEFAULT_TIMEOUT_SECONDS=45 and AUTH_PROBE_FAILED_INTERVAL_SECONDS=60 for the probe timeout, producing the same avoidable retry_after health gating the precedent task fixed for antigravity.

owned: .orchestrator/test_provider_permissions.py: test_antigravity2_auth_probe_matches_antigravity_qualified_timeout proving the resolved _auth_probe_settings() parity, that an unconfigured provider still resolves the plain 45s global default, and that account/home/retry state stays distinct between the two provider lanes
not_changing: The global provider_auth default block and AUTH_PROBE_DEFAULT_TIMEOUT_SECONDS/AUTH_PROBE_FAILED_INTERVAL_SECONDS constants in provider_permissions.py
providers.antigravity2.account, providers.antigravity2.antigravity.home/config_home, providers.antigravity2.retry (credential/profile isolation and retry limits untouched)
Scheduler planning, dispatch ordering, global capacity limits (workload/concurrency), model rotation ordering, worker retry limits, provider binaries, login state, or queue state
_antigravity_auth_probe / _auth_probe_settings implementation in provider_permissions.py (config-only change; the generic settings resolver already reads providers.<id>.auth_probe)
composes_with: The supervisor's periodic provider-capability refresh (.orchestrator/provider_capabilities.json) and dashboard health rendering for antigravity2

local_verification.command: python3 -c "import sys; sys.path.insert(0,'.orchestrator'); import provider_permissions as pp; c=pp.load_config(); print(pp._auth_probe_settings(c,'antigravity')); print(pp._auth_probe_settings(c,'antigravity2'))"
local_verification.result: Both resolve probe_timeout_seconds=120, failed_probe_interval_seconds=60; a third, unconfigured provider (codex) still resolves the plain global default probe_timeout_seconds=45
